svg.title: Four Gates Before a GovPlanet Humvee Bid
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-govplanet-humvee-bid-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Four Gates Before a GovPlanet Humvee Bid; subtitle: Engine health, walk-away number, clearance wait, and paperwork; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the start clip show a first-crank fire, smooth idle, and no blow-by mist from the radiator cap?; pass next: G2; fail action: Kill the listing; a healthy truck costs no more at auction.; gate: G2; question: Is the walk-away number written down before the auction closes?; pass next: G3; fail action: Do not bid; 30-second overtime extensions pushed one win from $9,500 to $12,500.; gate: G3; question: Can you wait up to 12 weeks for end-use clearance and hit the seven-day pickup window?; pass next: G4; fail action: Pass; daily storage charges start once the pickup window closes.; gate: G4; question: Will your DMV accept the SF-97 paperwork and will an insurer take the six-digit serial?; pass next: Bid, budgeting invoice fees and broker shipping of $500 to $1,200 by distance.; fail action: Hold off until the DMV and an insurer both confirm.; caption: A $10,200 win invoiced at $12,290.40 after a $1,030 transaction fee and a $50 SF-97 fee, and broker shipping ran $850 from Albany, Georgia to St. Louis, Missouri.; assumptions note: Gate order is an organizing sequence; each gate condition and dollar figure is an attributed practitioner claim.; note: Attributed to Kevin24Seven (gtS8l93r5cw, F0AkAibFp2g, gXjTPh7cGHU), Split Builds (CkfJvTDwa2w), and Rattlesnake Defense (WzbjxUJRWKI).

text.title: Four Gates Before a GovPlanet Humvee Bid
text.tspan: Four Gates Before a GovPlanet Humvee Bid

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Does the start clip show a first-crank fire, smooth idle, and no blow-by mist from the radiator cap?; pass next: G2; fail action: Kill the listing; a healthy truck costs no more at auction.
gate: G2; question: Is the walk-away number written down before the auction closes?; pass next: G3; fail action: Do not bid; 30-second overtime extensions pushed one win from $9,500 to $12,500.

gate: G3; question: Can you wait up to 12 weeks for end-use clearance and hit the seven-day pickup window?; pass next: G4; fail action: Pass; daily storage charges start once the pickup window closes.

gate: G4; question: Will your DMV accept the SF-97 paperwork and will an insurer take the six-digit serial?; pass next: Bid, budgeting invoice fees and broker shipping of $500 to $1,200 by distance.; fail action: Hold off until the DMV and an insurer both confirm.

text.title: Assumptions: Gate order is an organizing sequence; each gate condition and dollar figure is an attributed practitioner claim.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Gate order is an organizing sequence; each gate condition and dollar figure is an attributed practitioner claim.
